region.name: the Ravenmarch
region.blurb: Golden fields in the west, deep forest and frozen moors in the middle, and in the east the dark harbour of Pearlcliff.

towns.name: Lionbridge
towns.blurb: The royal city of the Ravenmarch: white walls, red roofs, and a castle flying the Queen's banners.

mayor.name: Duke Rolf
mayor.title: Duke
mayor.avatar: white-haired, twinkling-eyed duke with a red beard braided with beads, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a gold chain of office
greeting: Lionbridge welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Lionbridge is the pride of the Ravenmarch, and we are glad to have you.

quest.title: A Love Letter for Fernwood
offer: Would you carry this love letter to Duke Jasper in Fernwood? It is, er, a private matter. Please don't read it.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Duke Jasper in Fernwood is waiting for the love letter.
done: A letter? For me? From Lionbridge? Oh my. Oh my, oh my.

shop.name: The Golden Sheaf

keeper.name: Dora
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: Best prices in Lionbridge! Well, the only prices in Lionbridge.

workshop.name: The Busy Anvil

keeper.name: Pip
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: Anvil, cauldron, grindstone: use what you like. Pedal hard and it all goes faster!

npcs.name: Robin
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: When I grow up, I'm going to be a hero too!
The Siren's Conch can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from a pearl set in two pieces of sea glass. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.

gives.line: Are you a real hero? Mum says heroes always carry healing draughts. Here, take one of mine!

npcs.name: Smith Linnea
npcs.avatar: muscular smith with soot-streaked arms and a leather apron
lines: Hammer and anvil, all day long. Look at these arms!
I can build up yours too, for a fee.
Digby's Trading Post in Thistlecombe sells sea glass.

spots.name: the Old Well
spots.text: You haul up the old bucket. Tangled in the rope is a Traveler's Tonic!

towns.name: Pearlcliff
towns.blurb: Empty quays, torn nets, and a harbour where nothing floats for long.

mayor.name: Lady Bryony
mayor.title: Lady
mayor.avatar: broad lady with freckles and a gap-toothed smile, a plum-coloured cloak, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Thank goodness! The Queen sent you!
The Kraken lurks in the deep below the harbour. Not a single boat has come home this month.

shop.name: The Last Candle

keeper.name: Wystan
keeper.avatar: huge shopkeeper with a braided blond beard and a fur vest

lines: Everyone else has gone, but somebody has to sell the potions.

workshop.name: The Last Forge

keeper.name: Hugo
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Fire's the one thing we have plenty of. Use the forge, and hurry.

npcs.name: Grandpa Fenwick
npcs.avatar: white-bearded grandfather on a bench, with a walking stick across his knees
lines: I've lived in Pearlcliff for eighty years, and I'm not leaving now.
The Trident of Tides, the Selkie Cloak and the Siren's Conch. The old songs say you need all three.

npcs.name: Watchman Ulric
npcs.avatar: exhausted young watchman in a battered helmet, holding a bucket
lines: I count the boats every morning. There are fewer every day.
My granny says the sea has a long memory. I hope it forgets us.

spots.name: the Ruined Hall
spots.text: In the rubble of the old hall you find a Greater Healing Draught, somehow unbroken.

towns.name: Fernwood
towns.blurb: A woodcutters' village in a clearing, where the sawmill hums and the air smells of pine.

mayor.name: Duke Jasper
mayor.title: Duke
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful duke with a bald head that shines, a long blue coat with silver buttons, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Fernwood welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.

quest.title: A Prize Pumpkin for Northreach
offer: Would you carry this prize pumpkin to Mayor Toby in Northreach? It is entered in their harvest fair. It will win, of course.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Mayor Toby in Northreach is waiting for the prize pumpkin.
done: What a pumpkin! First prize, easily. Don't tell the judges I said so.

shop.name: The Mossy Kettle

keeper.name: Osric
keeper.avatar: kindly old shopkeeper in half-moon spectacles and a knitted waistcoat

lines: Everything a traveller needs, and a few things they don't.

workshop.name: The Whittled Owl

keeper.name: Kit
keeper.avatar: cheerful tinker with a tool belt full of odd little tools

lines: The grindstone sings when you pedal fast. Make it sing!

npcs.name: Granny Fenella
npcs.avatar: tiny, kindly witch in a mossy shawl, with a toad sitting on her hat
lines: Nettle soup for strength, willow tea for aches. Nothing for goblins, sadly.
Old Mother Spider prowls the road between Greygate and Fernwood.

npcs.name: Marigold
npcs.avatar: broad woodcutter in a checked shirt, with a long axe and sawdust everywhere
lines: Hear that? A woodpecker. Or a goblin with a hammer. Hard to say.
The Golden Egg from Thistlecombe is hidden in the Old Chapel in Fernwood.

npcs.name: Mabel
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: Never swat a bee. It only makes the others cross.
The quickest road to Pearlcliff is the one from Fernwood.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: the Golden Egg.

towns.name: Northreach
towns.blurb: Terraces of snowy roofs climb the mountainside, joined by steep, icy stairs.

mayor.name: Mayor Toby
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: tall, thin mayor with a bushy black beard, a green velvet coat, and spectacles on a ribbon
greeting: Northreach welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Brr! Come in by the fire. It is cold here, but our hearts are warm.

quest.title: A Book of Songs for Fernwood
offer: Would you carry this book of songs to Duke Jasper in Fernwood? It is for their choir. They have been singing the same three songs for years.
You'll be well paid for your trouble.
quest.reminder: Duke Jasper in Fernwood is waiting for the book of songs.
done: New songs, at last! The choir will be thrilled. The neighbours, less so.

shop.name: Aldous's Trading Post

keeper.name: Aldous
keeper.avatar: cheerful bald merchant in a honey-coloured vest

lines: Shut the door! You're letting the winter in.

workshop.name: The Warm Hearth

keeper.name: Hale
keeper.avatar: wiry tinker with goggles, a tool belt and a grin

lines: Keep that fire roaring and you can make anything.

npcs.name: Odette the Slightly Singed
npcs.avatar: tall wizard in a starry indigo robe and a floppy pointed hat, with a crooked staff
lines: Ooh, I could do wonders with you. New hair? New cloak?
Magic is cheap. Well, sixty gold. That is cheap, for magic.

npcs.name: Juniper
npcs.avatar: freckled child with a wooden sword and a helmet three sizes too big
lines: Can I hold your sword? Just for a second? Please?
Have you ever fought a giant spider? What was it like?

npcs.name: Old Merrick
npcs.avatar: white-bearded grandfather on a bench, with a walking stick across his knees
lines: Back in my day the roads were safe. Mostly. Sometimes.
Go on, Hero. Show them what Northreach is made of.

gives.line: So you're the Queen's hero! Take this pearl, then. They say the Siren's Conch is made with one.

spots.name: the Snowman
spots.text: Inside the snowman, right where its heart would be: a Quickening Elixir!

towns.name: Heronmarsh
towns.blurb: A village of reed huts and boardwalks over the marsh. Everyone owns a punt.

mayor.name: Mayor Morwenna
mayor.title: Mayor
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful mayor with silver hair in a bun, a plum-coloured cloak, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Heronmarsh welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Forgive the smell; it is the bog.

quest.title: Holy Water for the Wedding
offer: The chapel font has run dry, and there is a wedding on Sunday.
The Iron Anvil in Greygate sells Holy Water, I am told. Bring me one, please.
quest.reminder: Have you found some Holy Water? The Iron Anvil in Greygate sells Holy Water.
done: Holy Water! The wedding can go ahead.

shop.name: Nell's Curios

keeper.name: Nell
keeper.avatar: brisk shopkeeper with a pencil behind one ear and a ledger under one arm

lines: Potions, poisons, er, remedies. Curios of every kind.

workshop.name: The Bog-Iron Forge

keeper.name: Leofric
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: The cauldron never stops bubbling. Put something good in it.

npcs.name: Oswin
npcs.avatar: lean ferry-keeper in a wide hat, leaning on a long pole
lines: Mind the water. It's deeper than it looks, and colder.
Sea monsters fear the lightning. A storm weapon would sting.

npcs.name: Fisher Florian
npcs.avatar: weathered fisher in oilskins, with a net over one shoulder
lines: The fish are biting early this year. Something's got them nervous.
The tide brings in all sorts. Pearls, if you look in the right places.

spots.name: the Reed Maze
spots.text: At the heart of the reeds, on a muddy tussock: a Potion of Might.

towns.name: Thistlecombe
towns.blurb: A shepherds' village of stone walls and windy hilltops.

mayor.name: Duchess Rowena
mayor.title: Duchess
mayor.avatar: plump, cheerful duchess with dark curls, a plum-coloured cloak, and a wheat-sheaf brooch
greeting: Thistlecombe welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
On a clear day you can see all the way to Lionbridge from here.

quest.title: The Golden Egg
offer: Our famous goose laid a golden egg, and somebody has pinched it!
A fox was seen carrying it toward Fernwood. Bring it back and I'll make it worth your while.
quest.reminder: Any sign of the Golden Egg? A fox was seen carrying it toward Fernwood.
done: The golden egg! And not even cracked!
Here is your reward, and well earned.

shop.name: Digby's Trading Post

keeper.name: Digby
keeper.avatar: soot-faced armourer with a thick moustache and a hammer on his belt

lines: Come in out of the wind!

workshop.name: The Hilltop Forge

keeper.name: Hester
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: Everything I own, I made right here. So can you.

npcs.name: Scholar Alfie
npcs.avatar: young scholar with ink-stained fingers and round spectacles
lines: Potions obey those who understand them.
I can teach you, for a modest fee.
The Mossy Kettle in Fernwood sells a Selkie Cloak. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.

npcs.name: Edmund
npcs.avatar: shepherd in a thick wool cloak, with a crook and a sheepdog at heel
lines: The wolves have been bold this year. Keep to the road.
Digby's Trading Post in Thistlecombe sells sea glass.

npcs.name: Edith
npcs.avatar: beekeeper in a white veiled hat, bees drifting lazily around
lines: Bees know when trouble is coming. Lately they won't leave the hive.
The Golden Egg from Thistlecombe is hidden in the Old Chapel in Fernwood.

spots.name: the Bell Tower
spots.text: Up among the bells, in a pigeon's nest: an Eagle Feather!

towns.name: Haybury
towns.blurb: Thatched cottages around a village green, with a maypole in the middle.

mayor.name: Countess Elspeth
mayor.title: Countess
mayor.avatar: broad countess with silver hair in a bun, a sea-green robe, and spectacles on a ribbon
greeting: Haybury welcomes you, Hero. We have heard all about you.
Try the bread. Everyone in Haybury bakes.

quest.title: A Wedding Cake for Greygate
offer: Would you carry this wedding cake to Lord Egbert in Greygate? My niece is getting married there, and nobody else can be trusted not to eat it.
They pay their couriers well, I promise.
quest.reminder: Lord Egbert in Greygate is waiting for the wedding cake.
done: The cake! And not a single fingerprint in the icing. Wonderful!

shop.name: The Golden Sheaf

keeper.name: Violet
keeper.avatar: freckled shopkeeper in a patchwork apron, with a cat asleep on the counter

lines: Best prices in Haybury! Well, the only prices in Haybury.

workshop.name: The Mill Wheel Workshop

keeper.name: Lem
keeper.avatar: broad smith in a scorched leather apron, with forearms like hams

lines: Mind the sparks, and put the tools back where you found them.

npcs.name: Hunter Bram
npcs.avatar: weathered hunter in green leather, with a hawk on one wrist
lines: Out here, the tough get through and the rest go home.
A few coins, and I'll make you as tough as old roots.
Old Merrick in Northreach has a pearl, and would give it to a hero.

npcs.name: Baker Sven
npcs.avatar: round, rosy baker in a floury apron, with a tray of buns
lines: Heroes need feeding. You look like you skipped breakfast.
Fresh buns every morning, before the rooster is up.

spots.name: the Old Chapel
spots.text: Behind the altar, in a dusty niche: a Carved Tusk.

towns.name: Greygate
towns.blurb: A walled town on a crag, guarding the only pass through the mountains.

mayor.name: Lord Egbert
mayor.title: Lord
mayor.avatar: stout lord with a red beard braided with beads, a fur-trimmed mantle, and a tawny owl on one shoulder
greeting: Ah, the Queen's champion! Welcome to Greygate.
Watch your step. Our streets mostly go up.

quest.title: Old Mother Spider
offer: Old Mother Spider has been prowling the road to Fernwood, frightening every traveller. Nobody dares to use that road any more.
Beat Old Mother Spider, and the Trident of Tides, which has hung in my hall for a hundred years, is yours.
quest.reminder: Old Mother Spider is still out on the road to Fernwood.
done: Old Mother Spider beaten? Then Greygate owes you a great deal.
As promised: the Trident of Tides. May it serve you well against the Kraken.

shop.name: The Iron Anvil

keeper.name: Silas
keeper.avatar: red-haired ex-sailor with a tattooed forearm and a gold earring

lines: Steel for heroes. Only the best, and the best isn't cheap.

workshop.name: The Stonecutter's Yard

keeper.name: Beatrix
keeper.avatar: glassblower with goggles pushed up into her curls

lines: The best anvil this side of the mountains. Strike while it's hot!

npcs.name: Peddler Una
npcs.avatar: round peddler under a huge pack hung with pots and trinkets
lines: Word on the road is that Pearlcliff is in a bad way.
I walk every road in the Ravenmarch. Most of them twice.

npcs.name: Old Arden
npcs.avatar: bright-eyed village elder with a knobbly stick and a patchwork cloak
lines: Sit a while, Hero. The young are always in such a hurry.
Mind the road to Haybury. It has a mind of its own.

spots.name: the Eagle's Nest
spots.text: High on the cliff, in an empty eagle's nest, lies a purse of 15 gold.

enemies.name: Giant Spider
enemies.taunt: A spider as big as a pony drops from the branches on a silver thread.

enemies.name: Goblin Scout
enemies.taunt: A goblin cackles and waves a rusty knife.

enemies.name: Brown Bear
enemies.taunt: A bear rears up on its hind legs. It smells of honey and bad temper.

enemies.name: Grey Wolf
enemies.taunt: A wolf slinks out of the grass, teeth bared.

enemies.name: Cave Bats
enemies.taunt: A swarm of bats pours out of the rocks!

enemies.name: Rock Golem
enemies.taunt: A boulder unfolds into a grinding, rumbling golem.

enemies.name: Wild Boar
enemies.taunt: A boar paws the ground and snorts.

enemies.name: Kraken Spawn
enemies.taunt: A squid the size of a rowing boat hauls itself onto the road.

enemies.name: Drowned Sailor
enemies.taunt: A sailor in dripping rags squelches toward you, seaweed hanging from her hat.

enemies.name: Giant Crab
enemies.taunt: A crab the size of a cart clacks its claws.

enemies.name: Wild Ram
enemies.taunt: A ram lowers its curly horns and paws the turf.

enemies.name: Thieving Gulls
enemies.taunt: A flock of gulls swoops down, screaming. One of them has your lunch.

enemies.name: Frost Sprite
enemies.taunt: A shivering sprite hurls a snowball. It is mostly ice.

enemies.name: White Bear
enemies.taunt: A white bear lumbers out of the snow. It looks hungry, and a bit annoyed.

enemies.name: Old Mother Spider
enemies.taunt: Old Mother Spider lowers herself from the treetops on a rope of silk. Her eight eyes glitter.
enemies.avatar: spider as big as a cart, with grey-striped legs and a crown of cobwebs

enemies.name: the Kraken of the Deep
enemies.taunt: The sea boils. Tentacles as thick as oak trees rise from the water, and something enormous blinks at you.
enemies.avatar: vast barnacled sea serpent with a mane of kelp and teeth like a portcullis

hints.text: Lord Egbert of Greygate keeps the Trident of Tides, and has promised it to whoever defeats Old Mother Spider.
Old Mother Spider prowls the road between Greygate and Fernwood.
The Mossy Kettle in Fernwood sells a Selkie Cloak. It costs a fortune: 240 gold.
Only a Selkie Cloak can turn the Kraken's freezing cold. The Mossy Kettle in Fernwood has one.
The Siren's Conch can't be bought or found: it has to be made, at the workshop in any town, from a pearl set in two pieces of sea glass. It takes a few minutes of hard pedaling.
Digby's Trading Post in Thistlecombe sells sea glass.
Old Merrick in Northreach has a pearl, and would give it to a hero.
The Golden Egg from Thistlecombe is hidden in the Old Chapel in Fernwood.
To defeat the Kraken you need the Trident of Tides, the Selkie Cloak and the Siren's Conch.
Sea monsters fear the lightning. A storm weapon would sting.
The quickest road to Pearlcliff is the one from Fernwood.

challenge.title: The Deep below Pearlcliff
summons: Ah, Hero, you came! Sit, please. I am afraid the news is bad.
The Kraken of the Deep has risen from the sea off Pearlcliff. It drags down every boat that leaves the harbour, and the town is going hungry.
Our scholars say three things can bring the Kraken down: the Trident of Tides, which the sea obeys, a Selkie Cloak against the cold of the deep, and the Siren's Conch, which stills the waves.
Gather all three, then go to Pearlcliff and face the Kraken. Talk to everyone: somebody always knows something.
Here is gold for the road, and a few draughts. My carriage waits to take you to Lionbridge. Go with my blessing.

lair.name: the Drowned Grotto
lair.text: The harbour mouth is a whirlpool of dark water. Broken masts poke out of it like bones.

victory: You blow the Siren's Conch, and the sea falls still as glass. The Kraken rises, blinking, into the sunlight.
The Trident of Tides crackles with lightning. With a last great splash, the Kraken sinks into the deep and does not come back.
By evening the boats of Pearlcliff are out on a calm sea, and the whole harbour is singing.
